messages:
berek: starting a short sync — PR incoming for the VPN->VPC migration guide + SDK examples for key rotation in air-gapped installs. want to catch link breaks before merge.
toni: nice. main things to validate: route propagation notes for AWS Transit Gateway, example iptables NAT for the installer host, and a small snippet showing the SDK HSM PKCS11 config.
li: i noticed earlier PR drafts left an absolute link to /internal/ops rather than the docs root — will catch that in a pass. also, can we show the `redwood-client` SDK call for rotate_key with both HSM and KMS backends?
frank: i can author the SDK examples. propose two short examples: one using the `kms` REST path (hosted reference) and one that posts to the local agent with PKCS11 hints for on-prem. keep them under 10 lines each.
berek: perfect. also include an explicit note about offline bundles: checksum verification uses sha256 on linux, and `shasum -a 256` on macos. previous confusion came from mixed examples.
toni: on the networking front i added a small table of required ports for the installer -> HSM appliance (TCP 1500, 1650) and the VPN appliance (UDP 500, UDP 4500). small ask: add a quick verify command for IPSec status.
li: suggested IPSec check for strongswan: `sudo ipsec statusall | grep -i established` — will paste that in.
frank: SDK HSM example (python) i pushed to the draft branch:
```python
from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(agent_url='http://localhost:8080')
client.rotate_key(key_id='root-2026', backend='pkcs11', pkcs11_slot=1)
```
frank: and hosted KMS example (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/rotate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"key_id":"root-2026","backend":"kms"}'
```
berek: tidy. can we add a one-liner for troubleshooting TLS when the agent is behind a proxy? e.g., `openssl s_client -connect localhost:8080 -servername agent.local`
toni: good idea. also, docs needs a tiny migration checklist: drain traffic from old VPN endpoint, update peering attachment, confirm route tables, then flip DNS. keep it as bullets.
li: i fixed the broken internal link and updated the relative path to `../reference/networking.md` so product docs CI should find it.
docs-bot: Preview build queued for PR #4621 — preview URL: https://docs-preview.internal/4621 :gear:
frank: small nit — the PKCS11 snippet needs `libpath` example for different distros; i'll add `/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so` and `/usr/lib64/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so`.
berek: done and pushed. also added an explicit HSM timeout note: some appliances close idle mgmt sessions after 30s, recommend a retry/backoff example.
toni: can someone sanity-check wording in the Transit Gateway paragraph? i try not to be prescriptive about cloud infra.
li: reviewed — trimmed a prescriptive sentence and clarified the customer must verify route advertisement on their side.
docs-bot: Preview build passed for PR #4621 — changeset ready.
berek: thanks all — i'll merge at EOD after CI stays green. leaving the PR open for post-merge invites to QA to test on our lab cluster.
